title: SchoolSphere — Connected School Management
description: A thoughtfully designed Flutter school management app connecting students, parents, teachers, principals and administrators through attendance, assessments, academic progress and everyday school operations.
servicesUsed: ["Mobile application development", "Product design", "Database architecture", "Role-based access", "Automated verification"]
projectOverview: SchoolSphere is a functional portfolio demonstration that brings the school day into one coherent application. Five roles share connected workflows while retaining clear permissions. The project includes an Android demonstration build, a responsive browser build, original branding, screenshots, tests and an optional live backend.
challenges: Connect attendance, test-taking, grading, family access and school administration without making the mobile experience feel crowded. Keep unpublished results and assessment answer keys away from student accounts, and make the project easy to demonstrate without live credentials.
solution: A Flutter application with role-specific dashboards and modular workflows. Local persistence powers the fictional demo; optional Supabase policies and server functions enforce school boundaries, academic visibility and assessment rules. Teachers save registers, students take timed tests, teachers review written answers, and parents see published progress.
features: ["Five role-specific experiences", "Student and teacher attendance", "Timed objective and written tests", "Reusable teacher question bank", "Marks, feedback and published report cards", "Homework and learning resources", "Parent access to linked children", "Timetables and school announcements", "Private participant messaging", "Principal leave approvals", "Admissions and student enrollment", "Student, staff and class directories", "Fee tracking and PDF receipts", "Library borrowing and transport schedules", "Light/dark themes and responsive layouts"]
results: Delivered a working portfolio demonstration with connected academic and administrative workflows, an Android build, rendered screenshots and automated workflow/layout/database checks. All identities and school data are fictional. Live services and store distribution require external setup.
